summary: Go: Group related fields. Print book.Pages.
introduction: A struct groups named fields. Here a book has one title and one page count.

blocks.text: Install Go 1.22 or later. Save one complete example as lesson.go and run go run lesson.go.

blocks.title: Group related fields

blocks.text: The Book literal fills Title and Pages. The dot reads just Title.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Exported field names begin with a capital letter.
